in_arabic.name: هانونة
in_arabic.long_meaning: A name of Arabic origin meaning 'She who is gracious and kind'. It is derived from the Arabic word 'Hanun' which means 'gracious' or 'kind'. This name is often given to girls to encourage them to be compassionate and caring towards others.

in_urdu.name: ہانونہ
in_urdu.long_meaning: A name of Urdu origin meaning 'Beloved' or 'Dear one'. It is sometimes associated with the Arabic name 'Hanoona' due to the similarity in sound and meaning, as both names convey ideas of kindness and affection.

in_hindi.name: हानूना
in_hindi.long_meaning: A name of Hindi origin meaning 'Helper' or 'Supporter'. It is derived from the Hindi word 'Sahayata' which means 'help' or 'support'. The name 'Hanoona' could also be interpreted to mean 'Gracious' or 'Kind' in Hindi, as these meanings are associated with the Arabic origin of the name.

in_pashto.name: هانونه
in_pashto.long_meaning: A name of Pashto origin meaning 'Beloved' or 'Dear one'. It is derived from the Pashto word 'Mulana' which means 'master' or 'teacher', but the name 'Hanoona' is often used to convey ideas of affection and kindness.
